OLR India ("we", "our", or "us") operates the platform available at olrindia.duckdns.org. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

Information We Collect

  • Name and email address (via registration or Google Sign-In)
  • Mobile number and address details (optional, provided by you)
  • Location data (only if you grant permission)

How We Use Your Information

  • To create and manage your account
  • To connect customers with local vendors
  • To send account-related emails (verification, password reset)
  • To improve our platform and services

Google Sign-In

If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email, and profile picture from Google. We do not access any other Google account data.

Data Security

We use industry-standard security measures including encrypted passwords, HttpOnly cookies, and HTTPS to protect your data.

Third-Party Services

We use Firebase (Google) for authentication and Resend for transactional emails. These services have their own privacy policies.

Your Rights

You may request deletion or export of your personal data at any time by contacting us at support@olrindia.com.

Contact

For any privacy-related questions, email us at support@olrindia.com.

By using OLR India ("Platform"), you agree to these Terms. Please read them carefully.

1. About OLR India

OLR India is a rental marketplace that connects customers looking to rent products with local vendors. We are a platform only -we do not own, rent, or sell any products listed.

2. User Accounts

  • You must provide accurate information when registering.
  • You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure.
  • You must be at least 18 years old to use this platform.

3. Vendor Responsibilities

  • Vendors are responsible for the accuracy of their listings.
  • Vendors must honour rental agreements made through the platform.
  • OLR India is not liable for disputes between customers and vendors.

4. Prohibited Use

  • You may not use the platform for illegal activities.
  • You may not post false, misleading, or fraudulent listings.
  • You may not harass or harm other users.

5. Intellectual Property

All content, logos, and design on OLR India are owned by OLR India. You may not copy or reuse them without permission.

6. Limitation of Liability

OLR India is not liable for any damages arising from use of the platform, rental transactions, or disputes between users and vendors.

7. Changes to Terms

We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes means you accept the updated terms.

8. Contact

For questions about these terms, email us at support@olrindia.com.
